verdict.rationale: Rootly documents AI governance controls: a team-wide AI opt-in, per-feature toggles, and permission gating for Slack messages. None of the evidence says customer data is excluded from AI model training, or that users can opt out of training use. These controls govern whether AI features run, not whether data trains models, so they are adjacent and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models

citations.quote: Govern Rootly AI from AI & Agents: the team-wide opt-in, per-feature toggles, AI SRE access, and what each connector can read or change.
